Why buy here

What you get from Pillai Auto

Four showrooms, one dealership

Buy in Chennai, service in Chengalpattu, ride to Puducherry. Your records follow you across all four, and so does the warranty.

Test rides that are actually rides

Not a lap of the car park. Take it onto the road, sit two-up, try the traction control in the rain. Free, and no obligation.

A finance desk, not a phone number

Multiple lenders, zero down payment options, tenures to five years. Most approvals come back the same day you apply.

Service and genuine parts in-house

Periodic service, warranty work, battery diagnostics and Ather-genuine accessories — not sourced from somewhere else.

FAQs

Buying an Ather in Chennai

If you ride alone and want the full feature set, the 450X. If you carry a pillion, school bags or groceries, the Rizta Z. If the budget is the deciding factor, the new Konarc from ₹99,999, or the 450S or Rizta S. Tell us your daily distance and we will narrow it in one call.

On-road adds Tamil Nadu RTO charges, insurance and any accessories to the ex-showroom price. Use the estimator on our price page for a close figure, then ask us for a written quote — that is the number that binds.

The IDC figures are lab numbers. In Chennai traffic most riders see roughly 105–130 km from the 3.5 kWh pack on the 450 (Ather's TrueRange is 130 km), and a little more on the Rizta because it is geared gentler. Air conditioning of the commute — traffic, flyovers, riding mode — moves it.

At home on the bundled charger overnight, and on Ather Grid fast chargers around the city for up to 30 km of range in ten minutes on the 3.5 kWh 450X, Apex and Rizta Z (15 km on the others). We will map the chargers on your route before you buy.

Yes. Our finance desk works with multiple lenders, zero down payment options are available, and most approvals come back the same day. We also take exchanges on petrol two-wheelers.

It depends on the model and colour. Popular 450X colours usually move fastest. Call the showroom for the current position rather than relying on a page that may be a week old.
